fixed_findings: Missing tumor header now stops before an invalid bcftools index can crash.
Allele balance is genotype-level and preserves hom-alt-only sites.
The cyvcf2 predicate contains QD, SOR, and rank-sum checks.
Zero-valued DP or MQ no longer masquerades as a missing annotation.

functional_suitability.note: Separate SNP/indel, site/genotype, somatic, and caller-native paths are explicit.

reliability.note: Missing annotations pass only where intended; zero DP/MQ now fail; the somatic header guard is tested.
